reason: The hypothesis synthesizes active learning ML potentials, umbrella integration, and explicit ab initio corrections for electron–vibration coupling into a single workflow for fusion free energies of multicomponent HEAs. No passage proposes this combination; P5 and P18 apply ML or AIMD to MoNbTaW but do not address electron–vibration coupling or fusion free energies, and P7/P10 use ML+umbrella integration only for catalytic barriers, not for solid–liquid phase transitions with anharmonicity and electron–vibration coupling.
